query_referencia: SELECT COUNT(*) AS qtd FROM despesa_pagamento WHERE ano_referencia = 2023;
query_gerada: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT seq_pagamento) AS total_pagamentos FROM despesa_pagamento WHERE ano_referencia = 2023 AND COALESCE(nom_credor, '') NOT ILIKE '%NAO INFORMADO%' AND COALESCE(num_doc_credor, '') NOT IN ('-1', '0');
